features.text: Advanced rigid support system provides optimal stabilization for post-surgical recovery and spinal fracture management while maintaining comfort during the healing process
Modular panel system allows progressive adjustment of compression levels as you advance through various stages of post-operative recovery
Multiple sizing options with slim and regular profiles ensure proper fit and support for various body types during the rehabilitation process
Professional-grade construction delivers reliable spinal stabilization while maintaining a discrete profile for daily wear during recovery

measurement: Select from 10 pre-cut sizes or universal option for optimal post-operative support. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for expert sizing assistance. Note: Panels sold separately to allow complete customization of your recovery support system.
